data.long_meaning: In Greek, Anastasie means 'resurrection'. This name is derived from the Greek word anastasis, which means 'rising again'. It is a fitting name for a child born into a Christian family, as it is a reminder of the resurrection of Jesus Christ and the promise of eternal life. The name Anastasie carries the meaning “Resurrection” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Anastasie usually hope their child will grow to embody resurrection and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the hope of new life and the promise of salvation.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anastasie total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: אנאסטסיה
in_hebrew.meaning: השם אנאסטסיה נגזר מיוונית ופירושו תחיית המתים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אנאסטסיה מקורו ביוונית עתיקה, ונגזר מהמילה 'אנאסטאסיס' (ἀνάστασις), שפירושה תחיית המתים או הקימה לתחייה. שם זה קשור קשר עמוק לנצרות, שכן הוא מתייחס לתחייתו של ישו ומבטא את האמונה בנצרות בקימה לתחייה של המתים. השם אנאסטסיה הוא סמלי לתקווה ולישועה בנצרות.

in_greek.name: Αναστασία
in_greek.meaning: Το όνομα Αναστασία σημαίνει ανάσταση και αναγέννηση
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αναστασία προέρχεται από την αρχαία ελληνική λέξη 'ανάστασις' (ἀνάστασις), που σημαίνει ανάσταση ή επάνοδος στη ζωή. Στο χριστιανικό πλαίσιο, το όνομα αυτό συνδέεται με την ανάσταση του Ιησού Χριστού και συμβολίζει την ελπίδα και τη σωτηρία. Η Αναστασία είναι όνομα που φέρει ισχυρή πνευματική και ιστορική σημασία στην παράδοση της Ανατολικής Ορθοδοξίας και της Καθολικής Εκκλησίας.

The name Anastasie also holds a prominent place in the Eastern Christian tradition and continues to be passed down through generations.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Anastasie lies in its connection to the Christian faith and the promise of eternal life. The name serves as a reminder of the resurrection of Jesus Christ and the hope of spiritual renewal and transformation that comes through faith. The name Anastasie is also a symbol of God's power to bring new life and healing to those who are broken and lost. Those who bear this name are called to embrace the spirit of resurrection in their own lives, to rise above difficulties and challenges, and to live in hope and faith.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Anastasie means "Resurrection of Christ" in Greek. It symbolizes the spiritual rebirth and renewal in Christ, reminding us of His sacrificial death and glorious resurrection.

historical_references.reference: Anastasia of Sirmium (d. 304 AD): A Christian martyr and virgin, Anastasia was born in Sirmium, now Szirmabesenyő, Hungary.
